title: Slice of pizza with a smiling face
svg:

  <path d='M50 22 L24 78 Q50 86 76 78 Z' fill='#f7d94c'/>

  <circle cx='58' cy='54' r='5.5' fill='#d8402f'/>

  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='58' r='3.5' fill='#ff9e8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='3.5' fill='#ff9e8a' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
